name: Perplexity MCP Server
summary: Official MCP server for the Perplexity API Platform giving agents real-time web search, reasoning and research via the Agent and Search APIs.
description: Hosted remote server over Streamable HTTP, or run locally with `npx -y @perplexity-ai/mcp-server`. Also packaged as a Claude Code plugin and an Agent Plugin.

agent_access.notes: Send the Perplexity API key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
